messages:
mia_cs: Quick note - renewal queue dipped this morning. Looks like ~430 accounts moved from 'in-progress' -> 'no_activity' after last night's sync. Audit shows CRM `last_touch` updated by the import, but product telemetry has zero events. Could be a reconciliation bug. Anyone around? :confused:

owen_eng: I see the job logs. The reconcile pipeline currently backfills `last_touch` from contact records when no telemetry exists. That's bad for recency features.

tessa_data: yep. Proposed runbook: (1) create a reconciliation step that only backfills `last_touch` when `telemetry_event_count >= 1` OR `manual_verified = true`; (2) mark backfilled rows with `reconciled_by=crmsync` so we can filter them; (3) add a one-week probation tag `recon:needs-verification` to stop playbooks acting on them.

mia_cs: sounds good. can we run a quick dry-run to see how many accounts would be tagged? want ARR split and a sample for AEs.

reconcile-bot: dry-run complete for job crmsync-2026-08-11. total_backfills: 432 -> would_tag_probation: 392 (90.7%) -> would_block_playbooks: 392.
reconcile-bot: ARR buckets: <10k: 360 probationed; 10k-100k: 25; >100k: 7. sample_ids: [acct_9821, acct_3345, acct_7742, acct_4410, acct_1029].

noah_ae: appreciate the sample. please route >100k to the AE manual-verify queue instead of silent probation so we don't miss renewals.

owen_eng: done. rule snippet for staging:
```
if telemetry_event_count == 0 and source in ["csv","sf_import"]:
  set_tag("recon:needs-verification")
  suppress_playbook(7 days) unless ARR > 100000 -> route(manual_verify_queue)
  log_attrs: ["reconciled_by","import_job_id","enrichment_confidence"]
```

tessa_data: also adding a dashboard widget showing delta in weekly outreach volume if suppression enabled. Mia - want a one-page runbook for CS with instructions to mark `manual_verified` after AE checks?

mia_cs: yes please. include quick steps for export -> review -> mark verified. I'll prep comms to enablement and set expectation on renewal lists. Let's stage dry-run for 48h and re-evaluate. :thumbsup:
